info.title: TiDB Link Customer API
info.description: Customer integration API at /api/v1. Operations declare Business User API Key, Organization API Key or ticket authorization. Old customer addresses have been removed without aliases; existing SDKs and external callers require a separate migration.

UserApiKey.description: Opaque ti_user_<id>_<secret> credential: ASCII alphanumeric id body (1–64), unpadded base64url secret (43 characters from 32 random bytes). Authenticates the bound User and Organization. The persisted key owner determines scope.

OrganizationApiKey.description: Opaque ti_org_<id>_<secret> credential: ASCII alphanumeric id body (1–64), unpadded base64url secret (43 characters from 32 random bytes). Authenticates an Organization machine principal with no acting User. Each handler explicitly chooses whether to admit this principal kind.
